title: Naxxramas
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: You disappoint me, Garek. Perhaps if I tear open your memories...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No! Get out... of my head...

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: What’s this? You’ve been setting bombs throughout Naxxramas?
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]What’s this? You’ve been setting bombs throughout Naxxramas?[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Stop! What are you doing?!
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Stop! What are you doing?![/"Surprised"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Crushing your pathetic hopes for victory.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Crushing your pathetic hopes for victory.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: No! Foul wretch!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]No! Foul wretch![/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: It seems you three are simply too stubborn to serve the Lich King. How unfortunate.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]It seems you three are simply too stubborn to serve the Lich King. How unfortunate.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Garek. Kill them, and then yourself.

lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: So our uninvited guests have finally decided to greet me.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]So our uninvited guests have finally decided to greet me.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: Sadly, you’ve come at an inconvenient time. I am currently preoccupied...

lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: With the annihilation of the Undercity.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Kel'Thuzad! You will answer for your crimes against Lordaeron!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Kel'Thuzad! You will answer for your crimes against Lordaeron![/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: And for the fall of Quel'Thalas!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]And for the fall of Quel'Thalas![/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Kelthuzad
lines.text: How quaint. But rabble such as you are none of my concern.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]How quaint. But rabble such as you are none of my concern.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: Rivendare! Make yourself useful and dispose of these pests.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Baron Rivendare...

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You... the little rat who dared to bite me in Stratholme. This is a welcome surprise.
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You... the little rat who dared to bite me in Stratholme. This is a welcome surprise.[/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now I get to finish what I started.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Now I get to finish what I started.[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was finished long ago. This time, I’m not here for vengeance.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’m here to protect the Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: What now? Without the bombs, how do we destroy the crystal before it fires another blast?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have... something else... with enough power to do it.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Light.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No. You are not immolating yourself in holy flame.
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]No. You are not immolating yourself in holy flame.[/"Surprised"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: There’s no other way, Anya. The Light calls us... to protect those who yet live... so to speak.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We have all... lost something we had in life... and built something new in undeath. I will preserve it... at any cost.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Not because of the Light... but for... the Forsaken.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I have known many paladins in my time. Fewer heroes. You, Garek, I shall always remember and revere.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Light be with you, my friend.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I should have let Putress use you for parts.
lines.raw: ["Sad" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I should have let Putress use you for parts.[/"Sad"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Watch over the Undercity, Anya. I won't... be the last... who awakens in need of guidance.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Watch over the Undercity, Anya. I won't... be the last... who awakens in need of guidance.[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: No, you won't. Thanks to you, the Forsaken will survive.
lines.raw: ["Sad" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]No, you won't. Thanks to you, the Forsaken will survive.[/"Sad"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That’s the real victory. Never lose sight of it.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]That’s the real victory. Never lose sight of it.[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Remember the plan. We strike fast, set the bombs, and return to the sky barge before detonating them.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Prepare to meet heavy resistance ahead. These halls are occupied by many of the Scourge’s elite forces.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then it is fitting that the Forsaken have sent our elite forces to complete this mission.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: And the Argent Dawn as well, I suppose.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]And the Argent Dawn as well, I suppose.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I shall do my best to prove worthy of your company.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You already have, Leonid. Now let’s move.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Whatever this place is meant to be, it was heavily defended. Let’s place the last explosive.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Do my ears deceive me? Could that be Garek Bandarion?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Who are you? How do you know my name?
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Who are you? How do you know my name?[/"Surprised"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: You don't remember me
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You don't remember me[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I am Ilastar Songbreeze, and you gave me the greatest gift of all. My demise.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I am Ilastar Songbreeze, and you gave me the greatest gift of all. My demise.[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Ilastar? What are you talking about?
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Ilastar? What are you talking about?[/"Surprised"]

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Because of you, I have been remade in undeath. I am an instrument of the Lich King’s will! And now, you shall all enjoy the same honor.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I will enjoy putting an arrow through your throat.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: What horrid company you keep these days, Garek. No matter. If you will not bow, then you will kneel.
lines.raw: ["Happy" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]What horrid company you keep these days, Garek. No matter. If you will not bow, then you will kneel.[/"Happy"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It always has to be spiders, doesn’t it?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: These creatures will soon be the least of our concerns.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Arach Gate Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Some of these gates appear to open from only one side. We'll have to find a way around them.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Kill that nerubian before it ensnares us in its webs!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Here’s where we should plant the first explosive. Clear the area!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss CryptLord Start Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It’s an ambush! Watch yourselves!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss CryptLord End Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ve secured the area! Let’s plant the explosives and push forward!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: This is the wing of the necropolis where they assemble their flesh golems and other abominations.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then we shall disassemble them as we make our way through.

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Captain Bandarion, is that you?! Help!

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Thank you, sir! The Scourge took us and several other prisoners in the battle below.

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Our enemies will fall!

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Ready to fight!

lines.speaker: Deathguard
lines.text: Victory for Sylvanas!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll find them and set them free. With us, deathguards!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I remember this gate. The switch to open it should be somewhere nearby.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Cons MassArmy GateOpen Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: That should have opened the gate. And it sounds like we have company.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The master of this necropolis, Kel’Thuzad... who is he?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: A necromancer who spread the plague of undeath across Lordaeron. Prince Arthas killed him, but then later resurrected him as a lich.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: To do so, he slaughtered my people and defiled the Sunwell. Our kingdom died so that Kel’Thuzad could be reborn.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I won’t let the Undercity fall as well. I failed my people in life. I’ll do everything in my power to protect the Forsaken.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Cons CorpseTitan See Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: This is where we should place the next explosive.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Cons CorpseTitan See Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Then let’s deal with that monstrosity and do it.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss CorpseTitan End Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That was a big one. Everyone all right?

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss CorpseTitan End Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well enough. Let’s plant the explosives and keep moving.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scourge are raising orcs into undeath as well. They would make for terrifying death knights.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That skeleton... it’s gargantuan!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I doubt we’ll be able to fell it on our own. We must outwit it instead.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Reje GiantGate Open Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This gate requires a key. I’d wager that lumbering skeleton is the one who holds it.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These flames... if we can trap the skeleton in here, we might be able to defeat it.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Reje Giant Key Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The guardian is slain. Quickly, take its key so we can press on.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scourge’s depravity is on full display. Would that I could smite them all with the Light.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Could it even reach us here? We’re surrounded by death and darkness.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: There is nowhere beyond the Light’s reach. One need only have faith.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Bold words for one whom the Light would burn to a crisp.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight Start Q
lines.speaker: Sir Zeliek
lines.text: Turn back, intruders! Else I will be forced to slay you!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight Start Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Sir Zeliek... he was once a paladin of the Silver Hand!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight Start Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: And now he’s in our way.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight LightAbilities Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: You wield the Light as one of the Scourge? This is sacrilege!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight LightAbilities Q
lines.speaker: Sir Zeliek
lines.text: I pray that the Light destroys me for it. Then I shall at last be freed from my master’s command.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight End Q
lines.speaker: Sir Zeliek
lines.text: Only the Light... will free me... from servitude...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight End Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He could call upon the Light, even in undeath...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss DeathKnight End Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Scourge will raise him again, and continue twisting his faith into torment. Sir Zeliek deserves far better than this.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss PlagueBeast Start Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What the hell is that thing?

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss PlagueBeast Start Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The result of another twisted experiment. Slay it so we can plant the next explosive.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss PlagueBeast End Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Disgusting creature. Let’s set the explosive and get out of this muck.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Watch out!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: These gates are linked by a chain of switches. We must trigger each of them in turn.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Arach SkyBarge Q NOT USED
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: This gate will lead us back to the skybarge when it's time to leave.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this? It looks like a cathedral.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Is there no limit to the Scourge’s blasphemy?!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar MindControl Anya Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Embrace the truth as I have, dark ranger. Quel’Thalas has fallen and the Sunwell is gone. The Scourge are our future now!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar MindControl Anya Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: My future is with the Forsaken! And yours is in the dirt!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar MindControl Leonid Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: You showed promise as one of the Scourge, Leonid Barthalomew. A pity you have squandered it by siding with the living.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar MindControl Leonid Q
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Argent Dawn renewed my faith in the Light. Their courage will destroy your dark masters!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar ShadowClones Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: It is not me who you face, but your own doubts and weaknesses!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar ShadowClones Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They’re just shadows! Vanquish them and focus on Ilastar!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar HolyWrath Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: How is this possible? How can you channel the Light?!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar HolyWrath Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: There is nowhere... the Light cannot reach. This... ends now!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar AvatarOfLight Q
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You... will not... command us!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar AvatarOfLight Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Garek! You’ll burn yourself to ash!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.The Necropolis.Transmission Boss Ilastar Phase4 End Q
lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: No! The Light will not take me!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar... I’m sorry for leading you to this fate.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: What do we do now? We have no way to bring down Naxxramas.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We... have to get rid of its crystal... before it fires another blast. And I know how to do it.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: You can channel the Light, just like Sir Zeliek... How is this possible?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I... can feel it burn... each time I call upon it. But... it still... comes to my aid...

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You can’t keep this up, Garek. The Light will destroy you.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I just need... to hold on long enough... to save the Forsaken...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I remember... everything. The mistakes I made... the lessons I failed to learn...

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You have to put that behind you. Being Forsaken means having the chance to define who you are.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You're right, Anya... But knowing who I was... has shown me who I want to be... and what I must do...

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: We are nearing the top of Naxxramas. I am certain we will soon face Kel’Thuzad himself.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: He brought ruin to humans and elves alike. Now he intends to exterminate the Forsaken. We cannot allow that to happen.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Come what may... the Forsaken will survive. I swear it... by the Light...

lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: You struggle in vain. Once I have empowered the crystal, your precious Undercity will be reduced to a blighted crater.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We won’t... let that happen!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The Light... it burns...

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Think yourself some sort of paladin, do you? I should sit back and watch you incinerate yourself!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Pathetic vermin! I am the master of Stratholme! You stand no chance against me!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Soon you will share the fate of the city you betrayed and destroyed.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Ascension.Transmission Boss Finale Phase2 End Q
lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: It is done! In mere moments, the Undercity will be no more!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Ascension.Transmission Boss Finale Phase2 End Q
lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: Until then, it seems you require aid, Rivendare. Allow me.

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Ascension.Transmission Boss Finale Phase2 End Q
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Now is our chance! Kill them both!

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Ascension.Transmission Boss Finale End Rivendare Q
lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: They... will raise me again... in Stratholme...

lines.scene: TRANSMISSIONS.Ascension.Transmission Boss Finale End KelThuzad Q
lines.speaker: Kel'Thuzad
lines.text: This is not the end for me. But it will be for you.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Anya has informed me of the events that transpired in Naxxramas.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: This battle--and the actions of Captain Bandarion--have given me much to consider.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: Were it not for Garek wielding the Light, and the Argent Dawn joining our defenses, then the Forsaken might have met extinction.

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: It is true that we are surrounded by foes both living and undead. And yet, there may be allies for us to discover as well...

lines.speaker: Sylvanas
lines.text: ...and perhaps this Forsaken kingdom need not stand alone.

lines.speaker: Blademaster
lines.text: For the Burning Blade!
